schema.title: Response Get My Trips V1 Me Trips Get
Response Get Insurer Drivers V1 Insurer Drivers Get
Response List Incidents V1 Me Incidents Get

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the consent text accepted.

deleted_files.title: Deleted Files
deleted_files.description: Raw chunk files removed from disk.

emergency_contact_phone.title: Emergency Contact Phone
emergency_contact_phone.description: Phone number of the emergency contact.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Secret key for the X-API-Key header. Shown once, stored only as a hash.

score.title: Score
score.description: Average driver score 0 to 100, higher is safer.

total_trips_90d.title: Total Trips 90D
total_trips_90d.description: Scored trips in the last 90 days.

total_distance_km_90d.title: Total Distance Km 90D
total_distance_km_90d.description: Distance in the last 90 days, km.

peak_g.title: Peak G
peak_g.description: Peak acceleration in g; null for speeding events.

EventResponse.title: EventResponse
EventResponse.description: A detected driving event within a trip.

GPSSample.title: GPSSample
GPSSample.description: One GPS fix. Coordinates are never accepted: they stay on the phone.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: The driver's answer after a crash alert.

type.title: Type
type.description: Incident kind; only crash is produced today.

time.title: Time
time.description: When it happened; naive values are read as UTC.

event_rates.title: Event Rates
event_rates.description: Raw event counts by type over the last 90 days (counts, not rates per km).

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Model version of the latest scored trip; 'unknown' if none.

passenger_share.title: Passenger Share
passenger_share.description: Share of trips classified passenger or transit (0 to 1).

label_sources.title: Label Sources
label_sources.description: Trip counts by label source. Keys: user, bluetooth, rules, unlabelled (empty object when the driver has no trips).

flagged_for_review.title: Flagged For Review
flagged_for_review.description: True when passenger_share exceeds the review threshold.

total_trips_90d.title: Total Trips 90D
total_trips_90d.description: Scored trips in the last 90 days.

total_distance_km_90d.title: Total Distance Km 90D
total_distance_km_90d.description: Distance in the last 90 days, km.

InsurerDriverItem.title: InsurerDriverItem
InsurerDriverItem.description: A driver row in the insurer driver list.

total_drivers.title: Total Drivers
total_drivers.description: Drivers with at least one scored trip.

total_trips_90d.title: Total Trips 90D
total_trips_90d.description: Scored trips in the last 90 days.

tier_distribution.title: Tier Distribution
tier_distribution.description: Raw count of scored trips per tier (not percentages).

average_multiplier.title: Average Multiplier
average_multiplier.description: Mean premium multiplier, weighted by trips per tier.

imu_samples.title: Imu Samples
imu_samples.description: Number of IMU samples in the window.

SensorSnapshot.title: SensorSnapshot
SensorSnapshot.description: Summary of sensor data around a crash. Unknown keys (e.g. coordinates) are rejected.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Chunk sequence number from 0; re-sending a seq is idempotent.

imu.title: Imu
imu.description: IMU samples in ascending time order.

gps.title: Gps
gps.description: GPS fixes in ascending time order.

car_connected.title: Car Connected
car_connected.description: Whether the phone was connected to the car via Bluetooth during this chunk.

TripChunkRequest.title: TripChunkRequest
TripChunkRequest.description: Request body of POST /v1/trips/{trip_id}/chunks (one slice of sensor data).

status.title: Status
status.description: already_received when this seq was uploaded before.

received_at.title: Received At
received_at.description: When the chunk was first stored (UTC).

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Distance driven, km (0 if not yet computed).

duration_min.title: Duration Min
duration_min.description: Duration, minutes (0 if not yet computed).

score.title: Score
score.description: Trip score 0 to 100, higher is safer.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Model output 0 to 1 (higher = riskier); score = 100 * (1 - confidence).

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Risk tier derived from score; null if unscored.

score.title: Score
score.description: Trip score 0 to 100; null if unscored.

trip_type.title: Trip Type
trip_type.description: Who was driving; null until classified.

needs_confirmation.title: Needs Confirmation
needs_confirmation.description: True when the app should ask the user to label this unknown trip.

label_source.title: Label Source
label_source.description: Who decided trip_type; null if unlabelled.

transit_line.title: Transit Line
transit_line.description: Detected transit line for transit trips.

TripListItem.title: TripListItem
TripListItem.description: A trip row in trip lists.

trip_id.title: Trip Id
trip_id.description: Id of the new trip (status uploading).

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why processing failed; only set when status is failed.
